     NOTICE OF AGREEMENT REGARDING REMOTE CROSS-EXAMINATION
                       OF CHRIS ROWNTREE

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

        3 Trees Ranch Family LP and U3 Landowners (U3 Landowners) file this Notice of
Agreement Regarding Remote Cross-Examination of Chris Rowntree.
        On June 2, 2026, U3 Landowners filed a response to Brady Creek Intervenors’ Request to
Require In-Person Witness Attendance at the Hearing on the Merits. After that response was filed
and served, counsel for Brady Creek confirmed Brady Creek has no objection to cross-examining
Mr. Rowntree remotely.
        That agreement resolves the only pending request to require Mr. Rowntree’s in-person
attendance. No other party filed a request to require Mr. Rowntree to appear in person. If called
for cross-examination at the hearing on the merits, Mr. Rowntree will be available to appear by
Zoom.


        Filed: June 3, 2026
                                              Respectfully submitted,


                                             Benjamin Mathews
